response.overview: “Hiratsuka” is a 30-minute ethnographic film by anthropologist Dada Docot documenting Filipino migrant life in Hiratsuka, Japan. The film centers on the activities surrounding the staging of the Filipino community’s annual bingo in 2009, interspersed with conversations with members of the community and Gerald Daza Ballester, a former dancer-choreographer who lived undocumented in Japan for two decades. Hiratsuka has become their new hometown, where they have come to feel comfortable and have started families, despite various anxieties brought on by life in the diaspora.
response.title: Hiratsuka
